note: Non-authoritative projection of the source-controlled Volume 10 corpus (Packages 1-3). Confers no ratification and authorizes no implementation, expenditure, procurement, release, or deployment. Documentary and implementation-neutral.

decisions.title: Planning authority is separated from implementation authority
decisions.statement: Volume 10 establishes that authoring a delivery plan, estimate, decision, or readiness recommendation never authorizes implementation, provisioning, procurement, execution, or release. Implementation authority is granted only by a distinct future authorization gate.
decisions.context: The House governance model requires fail-closed separation between planning and execution to prevent a plan from being mistaken for an authorization.
decisions.consequences: Every Volume 10 record is execution-neutral; no record may set authorizes_implementation to true; execution is deferred to future gates.
decisions.prohibited_inference: This decision must not be read as authorizing any construction, provisioning, procurement, staffing, test execution, release, or deployment.

decisions.title: Estimates, target dates, and environment definitions are non-committal
decisions.statement: Volume 10 establishes that an estimate is not an approved budget, a target date is not a committed date, an environment definition is not a provisioned or qualified environment, a test-enablement plan is not an executable test, and a release candidate is not an accepted release or deployment.
decisions.context: Delivery planning must record intent without creating financial, schedule, staffing, provisioning, or release commitments.
decisions.consequences: Estimates carry a planning-estimate posture; commitments carry a not-committed posture; environments carry a not-authorized provisioning status until a future provisioning gate.
decisions.prohibited_inference: This decision must not be read as approving any budget, committing any date, provisioning any environment, engaging any provider, or accepting any release.

decisions.title: Package 2 is bounded to a club-affiliation implementation plan only
decisions.statement: Upon Gate V10-G1 passing, Package 2 is authorized only to author a club-affiliation implementation PLAN. It is not authorized to construct, provision, test, procure, release, or deploy anything.
decisions.context: The delivery-planning foundation must bound the next package so that downstream work remains documentary until a distinct implementation authorization gate is passed.
decisions.consequences: Package 2 scope is constrained to planning; execution remains gated.
decisions.prohibited_inference: This boundary must not be read as authorizing any Package 2 implementation activity beyond authoring a plan.

decisions.title: Club affiliation is the first implementation vertical
decisions.statement: The affiliation vertical is selected as the first implementation vertical for the House.
decisions.context: Recorded during authoring of the Volume 10 Package 2 affiliation implementation and technical-delivery plan.
decisions.consequences: The affiliation lifecycle exercises the full governed pathway and House P0 findings.
decisions.prohibited_inference: This decision authorizes no construction, provisioning, procurement, staffing, test execution, release, or deployment.

decisions.title: House and Button responsibilities remain distinct
decisions.statement: House institutional authority is separated from Button client experience.
decisions.context: Recorded during authoring of the Volume 10 Package 2 affiliation implementation and technical-delivery plan.
decisions.consequences: The Button remains a governed consumer of House contracts and performs no independent institutional mutation.
decisions.prohibited_inference: This decision authorizes no construction, provisioning, procurement, staffing, test execution, release, or deployment.

decisions.consequences: Domain modules request transitions but never mutate governed state directly.
decisions.prohibited_inference: This decision authorizes no construction, provisioning, procurement, staffing, test execution, release, or deployment.
